en.title: Number of Distinct Dates with an Odd Number of Birthdays
en.description:
Given the integer date identifier of each birthday celebration, count the distinct identifiers that occur an odd number of times. The answer is a count, not a particular date value that occurs an odd number of times; there may be several dates with odd counts.

See the input protocol for this site's supplements to missing ranges and its recovery of typos in the source.
en.input: The first line contains N, and the second line contains N integers. The original gave no bounds on the count or the date values; this site uses 0≤N≤200000 and identifiers in −10^9..10^9, treated as abstract date labels and not further restricted to 1..31 because of the birthday story.
en.output: Output a single integer, the answer.
en.explanation: The outputs of the three public examples are, in order: 3; 2; 0. Verified by independent enumeration or direct simulation.
hints: Keep a set of the identifiers that currently occur an odd number of times: when you meet an identifier, remove it if it is in the set, otherwise add it; finally return the size of the set.
